Source: https://www.vincenzosplate.com/neapolitan-pizza-dough/
L01 Name: Neapolitan Pizza Dough
L02 Declared yield: 4-5 dough balls (approx. 250 g each).
L03 Dough ingredients: 1 kg flour (Tipo 00), 600 ml lukewarm water, 30 g sea salt, 1-2 g fresh yeast.
L04 Dissolve the sea salt completely into the lukewarm water in a large mixing bowl.
L05 Add approximately 10% of the flour and mix until dissolved.
L06 Add the fresh yeast and mix until completely dissolved.
L07 Gradually incorporate the remaining flour while mixing by hand until the dough comes together.
L08 Turn the dough onto a wooden work surface and knead vigorously for 15-20 minutes until smooth and elastic.
L09 Cover the dough with a damp cloth and rest for at least 2 hours at room temperature (approx. 20 C).
L10 Divide the dough into 4-5 equal portions (approx. 250 g each) and shape into smooth balls.
L11 Place the dough balls into a proofing box, cover, and ferment for 24 hours at 16-18 C.
L12 Stretch each dough ball by hand into a 12-inch round, pushing air toward the rim. Do not use a rolling pin.
L13 Note: Baking in a wood-fired oven at 500 C for 60-90 seconds and toppings are out-of-scope for dough.
